verdict.rationale: Origin-country guidance is a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows only general U.S. and Canadian visa, start-up and investor pathway pages. None of it covers consulate processing, per-country backlogs, or pages aimed at founders from specific countries.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
